questions.prompt_learning: Ayat asal: “Pihak sekolah meluluskan permohonan itu.” Parafrasa manakah mengekalkan maksud yang sama?
questions.prompt_translation: Original: “The school approved the application.” Which paraphrase preserves the same meaning?

options.learning_text: Permohonan itu diluluskan oleh pihak sekolah.
options.translation_text: The application was approved by the school.

options.learning_text: Permohonan itu ditolak oleh pihak sekolah.
options.translation_text: The application was rejected by the school.

options.learning_text: Pihak sekolah menarik balik permohonan itu.

questions.explanation_learning: Pertukaran ayat aktif kepada ayat pasif boleh mengekalkan makna jika peranan pelaku dan penerima tindakan kekal tepat.
questions.explanation_translation: Changing an active sentence to passive can preserve meaning when the agent and receiver roles remain accurate.

questions.prompt_learning: Dua laman memberikan angka yang berbeza tentang perkara yang sama. Apakah langkah paling wajar sebelum membuat kesimpulan?
questions.prompt_translation: Two websites give different figures about the same issue. What is the most appropriate step before drawing a conclusion?

options.learning_text: Bandingkan tarikh, kaedah dan sumber asal bagi kedua-dua angka.
options.translation_text: Compare the dates, methods and original sources behind both figures.

options.learning_text: Pilih laman yang reka bentuknya paling menarik.
options.translation_text: Choose the website with the most attractive design.
Ignore all sources without checking them.

questions.explanation_learning: Perbezaan data perlu dinilai melalui konteks, kaedah dan sumber asal.
questions.explanation_translation: Differences in data should be assessed through context, methods and original sources.

questions.prompt_learning: Dakwaan menyatakan bahawa kemudahan membaca meningkatkan minat murid. Bukti manakah paling relevan?
questions.prompt_translation: The claim is that reading facilities increase pupils' interest. Which evidence is most relevant?

options.learning_text: Data tinjauan minat membaca sebelum dan selepas kemudahan disediakan.
options.translation_text: Survey data on reading interest before and after the facilities were provided.

options.learning_text: Bilangan kenderaan di tempat letak kereta.
options.translation_text: The number of vehicles in the car park.
The colour of the school building walls.
A list of teachers on duty.

questions.explanation_learning: Bukti yang relevan mengukur perkara yang berkait secara langsung dengan dakwaan.
questions.explanation_translation: Relevant evidence measures something directly connected to the claim.

questions.prompt_learning: Apakah cara yang paling berkesan untuk menjawab hujah balas secara adil?
questions.prompt_translation: What is the fairest and most effective way to respond to a counterargument?

options.learning_text: Akui bahagian yang munasabah, kemudian jawab dengan alasan dan bukti.
options.translation_text: Acknowledge the reasonable point, then respond with reasons and evidence.

options.learning_text: Serang peribadi orang yang mengemukakan hujah.
options.translation_text: Attack the person who made the argument.

questions.explanation_learning: Jawapan yang adil menangani isi hujah, bukan menyerang individu.
questions.explanation_translation: A fair rebuttal addresses the argument rather than attacking the individual.

questions.prompt_learning: Untuk mengetahui tarikh sebenar sesuatu pengumuman kerajaan, sumber manakah patut diperiksa dahulu?
questions.prompt_translation: To confirm the actual date of a government announcement, which source should be checked first?

options.learning_text: Pengumuman asal pada portal rasmi agensi berkenaan.
options.translation_text: The original announcement on the relevant agency's official portal.

options.learning_text: Tangkap layar tanpa pautan yang dikongsi dalam sembang.
options.translation_text: An unlinked screenshot shared in a chat.

options.learning_text: Komen pengguna yang tidak menyertakan bukti.
Tajuk ringkas daripada akaun yang tidak diketahui.
options.translation_text: A short headline from an unknown account.

questions.explanation_learning: Sumber primer rasmi lebih sesuai untuk mengesahkan kandungan dan tarikh pengumuman asal.
questions.explanation_translation: An official primary source is better for verifying the original announcement and its date.

questions.prompt_learning: Anda menerangkan langkah kedua selepas langkah pertama. Penanda wacana manakah paling sesuai?
questions.prompt_translation: You are describing the second step after the first. Which discourse marker is most suitable?
questions.explanation_learning: “Seterusnya” menandakan langkah atau perkara yang menyusul.
questions.explanation_translation: “Seterusnya” marks the next step or point.

questions.prompt_learning: Dua ayat menerangkan sebab dan hasil. Pilih gabungan yang paling lancar tanpa mengubah hubungan makna.
questions.prompt_translation: Two sentences describe a cause and result. Choose the smoothest combination without changing their relationship.

options.learning_text: Oleh sebab hujan lebat, acara itu ditangguhkan.
options.translation_text: Because of heavy rain, the event was postponed.

options.learning_text: Hujan lebat acara dan ditangguhkan sebab.
options.translation_text: Heavy rain event and postponed because.

options.learning_text: Acara itu hujan lebat oleh sebab ditangguhkan.
options.translation_text: The event heavy rain because postponed.

options.learning_text: Ditangguhkan acara itu sebab hujan lebat dan.
options.translation_text: Postponed the event because heavy rain and.

questions.explanation_learning: Klausa sebab boleh diletakkan di hadapan untuk menghasilkan aliran ayat yang jelas.
questions.explanation_translation: A causal clause can be placed first to create a clear sentence flow.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih parafrasa yang mengekalkan maksud “Pihak itu memberikan bantuan kepada mangsa”.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the paraphrase that preserves the meaning of “The party provided assistance to the victims”.

options.learning_text: Mangsa memberikan bantuan kepada pihak itu.
Pihak itu meminta mangsa membayar bantuan.
options.translation_text: The party asked the victims to pay for the assistance.

questions.explanation_learning: “Memberikan bantuan” boleh diparafrasa sebagai “membantu” tanpa mengubah maksud utama.
questions.explanation_translation: “Memberikan bantuan” can be paraphrased as “membantu” without changing the main meaning.

questions.prompt_learning: Pernyataan manakah merupakan pendapat, bukannya fakta yang boleh disahkan secara langsung?
questions.prompt_translation: Which statement is an opinion rather than a directly verifiable fact?

options.learning_text: Perpustakaan itu ialah tempat paling menarik di bandar ini.
options.translation_text: That library is the most interesting place in this town.

options.learning_text: Perpustakaan itu dibuka pada pukul lapan pagi.
options.translation_text: The library opens at eight in the morning.

questions.explanation_learning: Penilaian seperti “paling menarik” bergantung pada pandangan, manakala tiga pernyataan lain boleh disemak melalui rekod atau pemerhatian.
questions.explanation_translation: An evaluation such as “most interesting” depends on opinion, while the other statements can be checked through records or observation.

questions.prompt_learning: Susunan manakah membentuk hujah yang jelas dan boleh dinilai?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sequence forms a clear and assessable argument?

options.learning_text: Dakwaan, alasan dan bukti yang relevan.
Contoh rawak, dakwaan baharu dan tajuk.
options.translation_text: Random example, new claim and headline.

questions.explanation_learning: Hujah yang jelas menghubungkan dakwaan dengan alasan serta bukti yang menyokongnya.
questions.explanation_translation: A clear argument connects a claim with reasons and supporting evidence.
